art_instructions: Draw a Korean aegyo cute style scene from a low, child-level perspective inside the cozy family house. The Dinosaur (pea-green with pale mint belly, round snout, short tail, three stubby fingers) stands on the left side of the frame and gently offers a tiny mother figure to Panda. Panda (charcoal limbs and ears, creamy white face and belly, large black eye patches, bright expressive eyes) stands on the right side, reaching out eagerly with tiny plush arms to receive the mother. The Dinosaur's posture conveys helpfulness and gentle care, with a slight forward lean and wide, friendly smile. Panda's expression shows relief and joy, with eyes wide and a small, happy mouth. The little mother toy is small and clearly identifiable, held gently between Dinosaur's stubby fingers and about to be received by Panda. The setting includes warm brown wooden floors and furniture, soft green cushions, and cream-colored curtains, maintaining the cozy woodland cottage feel. Use smooth monoline strokes (2–4 px at 1080p) in dark brown/charcoal, with minimal cel-shading and warm ambient occlusion. Background should be simple and airy with soft pastel colors and generous negative space. Composition should be centered with clear separation between the two characters. Ensure both characters are drawn in chibi proportions (2–3 heads tall) with large, widely spaced eyes and tiny noses/mouths.
